verdict.line: You lose if you let Yorick poke safely with E (Mourning Mist) and wall off every retreat; you win if you close the gap before W (Dark Procession) is up and stack Hemorrhage to five for the kill.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by Yorick's W (Dark Procession) wall, not raw damage — it's on a 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown, so there are real windows where he cannot cage you. Darius has to commit his all-in during those windows, using E (Apprehend, 535 range) to drag Yorick into melee before the wall goes up, then finishing with R (Noxian Guillotine) once Hemorrhage is maxed. The 47.8% win rate over 1144 games reflects a skill matchup where the losing side is almost always the Darius who fights into an already-placed wall.

theirWindow.when: He lands E mark with wall ready
theirWindow.what: Yorick can mark you with E (Mourning Mist) for the armor shred and slow, then drop W to wall off your escape or your allies while his Mist Walkers (from Q graves) chip you down. Back off rather than trade through it.

yourWindow.when: Whenever his W (wall) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no way to cage you or cut off the fight. Engage hard with E (Apprehend) to pull him in, land Q (Decimate) for the blade-side damage and sustain, and commit to the all-in.

powerCurve.note: Auto-attack trades and Q sustain win exchanges
E poke and ranked wall level the lane
R adds true-damage execute off Hemorrhage stacks
Graves and Maiden fuel his split-push pressure
Full builds normalize back to a straight duel

start.why: Sustains you through Last Rites (Q) heal trades and Mourning Mist (E) poke so you can keep contesting instead of shoving and leashing.

boots.why: Yorick's auto-attacks, Q, E, and Mist Walker hits are all physical — the flat reduction cuts down the poke you're trying to play through.

core.why: The active haste closes distance before Yorick can wall off his escape route or yours.
Charge-up speed lets you stick onto a kiting target and the HP backs your all-in.
Heals you back through the Mist Walker chip damage that stacks up over a prolonged fight.

situational.when: if you need more raw survivability to force the all-in through his heal and walkers
if the jungler or mid lane is adding significant magic damage on top of Yorick
if you need the extra mobility to catch him before he gets a wall down

runes.keystoneWhy: The burst of movement speed after sustained combat is what lets you close on Yorick and stay on him instead of getting kited off and walled out of the fight.

summoners.why: Ghost is the highest win-rate, most-picked choice here (48.2%, 68.8% pick) because it closes the gap on Yorick before Dark Procession goes up; Flash is your backup engage or escape if he walls you off anyway.

playing.title: Trade before the wall is ranked
playing.detail: At rank 1, Dark Procession (W) is on a 20s cooldown — early levels are your best window to fight without worrying about being walled off.

playing.title: Track his Q grave count
playing.detail: Every champion hit or kill from Last Rites (Q) digs a grave that later raises a Mist Walker. Letting him free-hit you repeatedly builds his sidelane army.

playing.title: Engage with E, don't just poke
playing.detail: Apprehend (535 range) is how you force the fight. Use it to drag him in before he can reposition behind a wall.

playing.title: Time the all-in for max stacks
playing.detail: Hemorrhage caps at 5 stacks and triggers an attack damage enrage. Land your damage, then commit R (Noxian Guillotine) once he's capped out for the true-damage spike.

playing.title: Disengage if the wall drops mid-fight
playing.detail: Dark Procession blocks movement outright. If it goes up between you and your escape or your support, reset instead of forcing a bad trade.

playing.title: Pressure his splitpush window
playing.detail: Around levels 9-13 his graves and eventual Maiden let him threaten sidelane. Shove and force him back to lane rather than let him roam freely.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning about the wall, grave stacking, and Hemorrhage timing is our own tactical read, not something OP.GG reports directly.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being caged inside Yorick’s (E). Rather than dealing burst damage, try to fight him in a prolonged fight after closing in successfully. Pressure him to gain control over lane.
